# Let a Workstation subclass choose the Workspace its viewport creates

## Context

An app that builds on the Workstation, for example a workspace app that extends `Workstation.view.Workspace` with its own stores and panes, has no way to get that subclass created. `Workstation.view.ViewportController#createRoot` names the class at its call site: `Neo.create(Workspace, {...})` at `apps/workstation/view/ViewportController.mjs:210` (`dev` `bb9f0311`).

The rest of the Workstation already supports the extension. `Workspace#createPane(itemId, item)` is a method a subclass overrides, and the root `stateProvider.stores` map is a config.

## The Problem

Swapping the workspace today means overriding `createRoot` in full. That is a ~60-line async method: it hydrates the topology library, validates the saved topology and writes the cold-hydrate transaction. A copy drifts from the original on every topology change, and a one-line seam avoids that.

## The Architectural Reality

- `createRoot(binding, layoutId)` (`ViewportController.mjs:172-232`) ends in `Neo.create(Workspace, {flex, initialTopology, topologyGroupId, topologyLibrary, windowId})`.
- `Workspace.MAIN_WORKSPACE_ID` is read as a static at lines 151 and 199. A subclass inherits it, so those reads stay valid.
- The Viewport takes its controller as a config, so a config object `{module: ViewportController, workspaceModule: X}` reaches a new controller config without subclassing the controller.
- Engine owners take the class to instantiate as a config elsewhere too, e.g. `Neo.grid.column.Tree` `defaults: {module: TreeComponent}`. A class named at its call site defeats replacement.

## The Fix

Add a `workspaceModule` config to `Workstation.view.ViewportController`, defaulting to `Workstation.view.Workspace`, and create the root workspace from it in `createRoot`. Its JSDoc names the two ways to set it: a subclass, or the controller config object.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Source of authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Workstation.view.ViewportController#workspaceModule` (new config) | this ticket; `createRoot` at `ViewportController.mjs:210` | `createRoot` instantiates this class for the main workspace, with the same config as today | unset → `Workstation.view.Workspace`, today's behavior | JSDoc on the config | unit spec in `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/ViewportController.spec.mjs` |

## Decision Record impact

none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Workstation.view.ViewportController` has a documented `workspaceModule` config that defaults to `Workstation.view.Workspace`.
- [ ] `createRoot` creates the root workspace from `workspaceModule`, and no other site in the controller instantiates the class.
- [ ] A unit spec in `ViewportController.spec.mjs` shows both the default and an override reaching the instantiation.
- [ ] The default path is unchanged: the existing Workstation unit specs pass.

## Out of Scope

- Making panes or stores swappable: `createPane` and `stateProvider.stores` already are.
- Any change to `Workstation.view.Workspace` itself.

## Avoided Traps

- Overriding `createRoot` in a subclass copies 60 lines of topology hydration, which then drift.
- Patching `Workspace.prototype` from the extending app mutates a shared class for every consumer.

## Related

- `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`: `createPane` and `stateProvider`, the existing seams.
